# Git

> The official Git distributed version control system documentation, tools, and community hub for developers worldwide.

Git is an open-source distributed version control system created by Linus Torvalds and maintained by the community. Git-scm.com serves as the primary reference for Git documentation, learning resources, ecosystem tools, and community support.

## Key Topics

- Git
- Version Control
- Distributed VCS
- Repository Management
- Git Ecosystem
- Command-line Tools
- GitHub
- GitLab
- Pro Git Book
- Git Workflows
- Branching & Merging
- Open Source
- Developer Tools
- Repository Hosting
- Git GUIs

## Getting Started

- [Git Homepage](https://git-scm.com): Git homepage with installation, basics, and Pro Git book by Chacon & Straub
- [About Git](https://git-scm.com/about): Overview of Git version control, performance, ecosystem (GitHub, GitLab)
- [Learn Git](https://git-scm.com/learn): Learning resources: Pro Git Book, tutorials, cheat sheets, video lessons

## Reference & Documentation

- [Git Command Reference](https://git-scm.com/docs): Git command reference: CLI commands, workflows, branching, merging

## Tools & Ecosystem

- [Git Tools Directory](https://git-scm.com/tools): Git tools directory: CLI, GUI, hosting, and ecosystem integrations
- [GUI Clients](https://git-scm.com/tools/guis): Directory of Git GUI clients including GitHub Desktop and SourceTree
- [Command Line Tools](https://git-scm.com/tools/command-line): Command-line Git tools: lazygit, tig, forgit, gitui, gitu
- [Repository Hosting Services](https://git-scm.com/tools/hosting): Git repository hosting services: GitLab, Codeberg, Forgejo, Radicle

## Community & Support

- [Community](https://git-scm.com/community): Git community: mailing list, bug reporting, IRC, Git for Windows support
- [Donations & Support](https://git-scm.com/sfc): Git donations via Software Freedom Conservancy with PayPal support

## Optional

- [Site Information](https://git-scm.com/site): Site information: git-scm.com maintenance, MIT license, contributors
